title: KIVIK sofa
description: KIVIK sofa, Grann/Bomstad black Cuddle up in the comfortable KIVIK sofa. The generous size, low armrests and pocket springs with foam that adapts to the body invites you and your guests to many hours of socializing and relaxation. 10-year guarantee. Read about the terms in the guarantee brochure.
features: The seat- and back cushions and inside, outside, top and front of the armrests are covered with GRANN – a soft, smooth and strong grain leather with natural variations. Other surfaces have the coated fabric BOMSTAD.
materialAndCare: Coated fabric parts: 100 % polyurethane, 75 % polyester, 25 % cotton; Leather: Dyed through top-grain leather with a treated, embossed and pigmented surface; Back and seat frame: Particleboard, Plywood, Fiberboard, Solid wood, Polyurethane foam 1.2 lb/cu.ft.; Armrest frame: Particleboard, Plywood, Fiberboard, Solid wood, Polyurethane foam 1.5 lb/cu.ft.; Seat cushion: High-resilience polyurethane foam (cold foam) 2.2 lb/cu.ft., Polyurethane foam 2.0 lb/cu.ft., Felt liner; Pocket spring unit: Steel
